goal: Settle the integration node's audit on codex for the landed stem stack (jahala/plotplot 20): the same smoke and audit command, no builder.

accept.smoke: bash -lc 'cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test && bash scripts/fit/stem.sh bundles && bash scripts/fit/stem.sh hook-faces'
